title: Ag-catalysed double-benzylic isocyanation affording bisisonitriles and their utility as molecular linkers
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20459-20463
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04458H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Taiga Yurino, Tomoko Ishikawa, Takuya Nakamura, Kanon Ochiai, Shotaro Tanabe, Luxia Cui, Toshikazu Ono, Takeshi Ohkuma
Ag-Catalysed double isocyanation was successfully developed to afford bisisonitriles, which functioned as “molecular linkers.” These bifunctional compounds were utilized to construct linked photoluminescent compounds.
